facts.text: The image is a vertical, multi-panel character reference sheet on a dark background, divided into a large top hero panel, a middle row of three full-body turnaround views, and a bottom row of four detail close-ups, with a caption beneath each panel.

The recurring subject is a person with a lean build, light-to-medium skin, dark hair shaved close at the sides and gathered into a small top knot at the back, and a visible scar running through one eyebrow.

The subject wears an all-black outfit: a collared jacket with shoulder straps, buckle hardware and a high collar, a dark shirt underneath, black cargo trousers with pockets at the thighs, and black lace-up combat boots.
The top hero panel shows the subject standing full-body and centered on a wet, reflective paved surface at night, arms relaxed at the sides, head turned slightly to one side, with rain falling.

The hero setting is a dim urban exterior: metal railings run along both sides of the walkway, a building facade with lit warm windows stands to the right, and blurred lights recede into the rainy background.
The middle row contains three panels labelled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK, each showing the same subject standing full-body in the same black outfit against a plain dark studio backdrop.

In the FRONT panel the subject stands facing the camera with arms hanging straight at the sides and feet slightly apart; in SIDE PROFILE the body is turned in profile; in BACK the figure faces away showing the jacket's back and the top knot.
The bottom row contains four detail panels labelled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.
The FACE close-up shows the subject's head and shoulders against the dark backdrop, with the shaved-side haircut, the eyebrow scar and a neutral, direct gaze toward the camera.

The JACKET COLLAR detail shows a close crop of the jacket's high collar, fabric texture and a metal buckle and strap; the HANDS detail shows two weathered hands with visible veins against a dark background.
The BOOTS detail shows a pair of black leather lace-up combat boots with scuffed, worn surfaces and thick soles.

Lighting is low-key and moody throughout: the hero panel mixes cool blue-grey night tones with warm amber window lights and wet reflections, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft, dim frontal studio light against near-black backgrounds.
Legible caption text appears in the sheet: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.

limitations: Fine details of the jacket's hardware, fabric weave and boot construction are only partly discernible at this resolution.
No sound, motion or dialogue can be inferred from this still image.

facts.text: The image is a dark-fantasy dragon character reference sheet: one wide hero illustration at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in a second row, and four close-up study panels in a third row.
The depicted creature is a large black dragon with a long snout, several long pale horns swept back from its head, a spiny dorsal ridge, four clawed limbs, a long tail, and large membranous wings.

In the wide top scene, the dragon stands low on a wet rocky shore with its head dipped toward a shallow pool and its wings partly lifted, against a dark volcanic landscape with misty crags and an orange fiery glow at the right.
The second row contains three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR; all show the same dark-scaled dragon with spread wings and four legs.
The bottom row contains four close-up panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's reptilian head in profile, including the pale horns, a small amber-orange eye, and dark textured scales.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a dark, leathery wing membrane stretched between long bony wing fingers.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a heavy clawed foot with several thick curved dark claws resting on rough rock.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with a faint blue-gray iridescent sheen.
White all-caps labels appear on black bands within the sheet: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

limitations: Small background elements in the hero scene are obscured by shadow and atmospheric haze.
The dragon's exact size, age, sex, and species are not stated.
The sheet presents static views and cannot establish motion, behavior, or sound.
